# Burned Ledger Leaf

A charred corner of an accession ledger. Three surviving marks form half a shelf coordinate and an erased-wing heron drawn in iron-gall ink.

## Visible text

The surviving coordinate begins with `N-7`, but the final character is lost to fire.
